subject: SIG: Internal access control deep-dive and log-sampling runbook and scheduling
messages:
From: Evan Chou <evan.chou@acmecloud.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: security@acmecloud.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: access control deep-dive + log sampling demo

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick onboarding support on the SIG intake. Our security team would like to schedule a focused session to: 
- Walk through Redwood's internal access control model (roles, least-privilege boundaries, service accounts).
- See a short demo of log sampling and how we can pull near-real-time event slices for incident triage.
- Confirm KMS key scopes and cross-region key usage for retained logs.

Preferably next week — we have a couple of folks who need to see the runbook and an example sampling window. Can you share availability and any pre-read we should review?

Also: we will need recording consent and confirmation of what artifacts you can share post-call (redacted logs, sampling scripts).

Thanks,
Evan
Evan Chou
Security Engineer, AcmeCloud
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Chou <evan.chou@acmecloud.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: access control deep-dive + log sampling demo

Hi Evan — thanks for the clear ask. Happy to run this session. Proposed plan:

1) 30–45 minute call: agenda below.
2) Pre-read: we will attach an access_control_matrix.csv and a short PDF runbook for log sampling.
3) Recording: fine with us — we just need consent to keep a trimmed recording for internal follow-up and a redacted artifact bundle for you.

Agenda (30–45m)
- 5m: Introductions & scope (who needs admin vs. read-only)
- 10m: Access control model (IAM roles, service accounts, delegation paths)
- 10m: Live demo: log sampling run and pulling a 15-minute event slice
- 5m: KMS scope, key rotation cadence, cross-region considerations
- 5–15m: Q&A / next steps / follow-ups (artifact handoff)

Availability (PDT):
- Wed 2026-05-20: 10:00–10:45 or 14:00–14:45
- Thu 2026-05-21: 15:00–15:45

Kimberly, Marissa — can you join for the demo and handle the runbook walk-through?

Evan — if those times don't work, propose alternatives and we'll accommodate. I attached the two files we discussed (access_control_matrix.csv, log-sampling-runbook.pdf) — they contain the runbook steps and a redaction checklist.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Security Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: access_control_matrix.csv (CSV: role -> permission -> owner), log-sampling-runbook.pdf (PDF: steps + sample queries)
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: access control deep-dive + log sampling demo

Adding a few technical clarifications we should include on the call (so Evan's team has context and we can prepare screenshots/snippets):

- Sampling window: we typically demo a 15-minute live pull; confirm if they need a larger historical window (we'll note cost/IO implications).
- Log formats: we will show structured JSON events and an example flattened CSV for redacted output.
- Retention/access: explain role-based access to archival buckets and time-limited signed URLs for artifact delivery.
- KMS: explain customer-accessible key options vs. platform-managed keys; bring note on key rotation schedule and whether CMKs are AWS KMS or customer-managed HSM (if they require HSM we need heads-up).
- Evidence: what artifacts are acceptable for SIG/C A I Q? (e.g., IAM policy snapshots, anonymized audit logs, policy change history).

Prep items for this thread:
- Confirm final attendee list from AcmeCloud so we can tailor the demo.
- Confirm whether we should mask user IDs in the example outputs (recommend masks by default).

I can prepare short snippets to paste during the demo and a redaction checklist slide.

—Kimberly
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: access_control_matrix.csv, log-sampling-runbook.pdf
From: Evan Chou <evan.chou@acmecloud.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: security@acmecloud.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: access control deep-dive + log sampling demo

Jonas / Kimberly — thanks, that looks good. Confirming: Thu 2026-05-21 15:00–15:45 PDT works for our team. Will join: myself (Evan), Priya Singh (secops lead, priya.singh@acmecloud.com), and Marco Ruiz (platform ops, marco@acmecloud.com).

A few quick answers:
- We want a 15-minute live sampling demo + one historical pull (2–4 hours) to validate retention/access behavior. If you can show both that would be great; we understand any rate/IO caveats.
- Recording consent: we consent to the recording and appreciate the redacted artifact bundle. Please confirm an expected handoff timeline for the bundle (we'd like it within 48 business hours if possible).
- KMS: AcmeCloud prefers platform-managed CMKs for now; we may request customer-managed HSM later. Please note that in the call.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Evan
Security Engineer, AcmeCloud
